title: How CRE Enables Advanced Tokenization Use Cases | Sergey Nazarov on the Thinking Crypto Podcast
description:
Chainlink Co-Founder Sergey Nazarov joined the Thinking Crypto podcast and explained how Chainlink is the key orchestration layer for tokenization, and why the leading tokenization platforms are using the Chainlink Runtime Environment (CRE) to build advanced tokenization use cases.

Full podcast: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TpE2VwGsqlA

Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi. 

Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at chain.link.

✅ Subscribe and turn notifications on: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCnjkrlqaWEBSnKZQ71gdyFA?sub_confirmation=1

Learn more about Chainlink:

Website: https://chain.link
Docs: https://docs.chain.link
Twitter: https://twitter.com/chainlink

#Chainlink #crypto #blockchain

asr.full_text: So Chainlink is partnering with a lot of the top systems that tokenize things. So we've worked closely with Apex, we've worked closely with FireBlockz, we were closely with a number of top tokenization providers, Torus and others. So many, many top tokenization providers are already utilizing CCIP, the Data Oracles, Proof of Reserve, so the oracles, right? Now they can use CRE to do efficient orchestration around all those tokens that they're generating. And for fun tokenization, I think CRE is particularly useful because as we announced with UBS yesterday, there's an ability to provide transfer agency, there's an ability to provide key services that are critical to doing fun tokenization. So there's a way to provide key services that are critical to doing fund tokenization. So there's a way that the existing tokenization platforms use CRE. There's a way that the issuers of tokens, if they want to have deep personal control over tokenization, can use CRE. And there's actually all kinds of service providers that are available on CRE to make tokenization easier so like transfer agent service providers, data providers like those that we mentioned. So the Chainlink runtime environment is really kind of uh it's both a place to write the code that manages all these complex smart contracts. Hmm. But it's also the environment where you get a community and ecosystem of tools. So, when you go into the CRE, you'll have S&P data, Futsa Russell data, trade web data, all the other institutional data you need. You'll have Bricia's to chain, you'll have transfer agent services from various transfer agency providers, and so, you'll be able to build all of these advanced use cases for tokenization in the CRE. And then if you want to manage the token that you're building through a custody provider, like Fireblocks or Taurus, or Tokenia from Apex, or these other systems. You're able to do that.
